flags.title: Solid Gaming Officially Removed in Round 10 — Yet 72% of Hotspawn Crowd Picked Solid Gaming (#1071216)
flags.detail: Official Komplettligaen 2026 Autumn wikitext & GGArena standings explicitly declare `|excludeteams=Solid Gaming|dqteams=Solid Gaming` (Footnote 1: "Round 10: Solid Gaming is removed from the league"). All 4 prior Solid Gaming fixtures since Sept 17 remain unplayed (`0–0`) on Hotspawn, yet fixture #1071216 (Solid Gaming vs DMG Esports Norway, 2026-10-22 15:00 UTC) remains open with 72% of users picking Solid Gaming.
flags.resolution: Quarantined into Unresolved (Removed Team) with explicit warning: NEVER pick Solid Gaming; select active DMG Esports Norway if filling card.

flags.title: German Prime League Team `PvB Nation` Misbound as Defunct 2019 Vietnamese VCS Team `Phong Vũ Buffalo`
flags.detail: Hotspawn's upstream data provider matched short tag `PVB` in German Prime League Division 2.1 to historical Vietnamese VCS team `Phong Vũ Buffalo` (rebranded/defunct in 2019). Cross-checking the 8-team Division 2.1 roster on Leaguepedia & PrimeLeague.gg proves the actual team is German squad `PvB Nation`.
flags.resolution: Explicitly bound `(PRM 2nd Division 26-27 Fall, Phong Vũ Buffalo) -> PvB Nation` across all 5 open Division 2.1 fixtures.

flags.title: Symmetric `1.80 / 1.80` Unpriced Placeholder Odds Caught on LGC Rising Grand Finals (#1079080)
flags.detail: Esports aggregator listings display `[1.80 / 1.80]` symmetric placeholder numbers on `Mental Rush vs Vitality Rising Bees` despite zero bookmaker posting an actual line. Accepting fake `1.80 / 1.80` quotes would falsely erase Vitality Rising Bees' dominant undefeated playoff run (`2–0` GCS, `3–0` G2 Hel vs `#2` Mental Rush `3–2` SK Avarosa).
flags.resolution: `markets.devig_decimal_pair()` hard-rejects symmetric `1.80 / 1.80` placeholders and cascades #1079080 to Tier-2 EMEA Game Changers origination.

flags.title: Two Week 1 On-Rift Wins by `Team Reds` Overturned to Forfeit Losses for Ineligible Roster
flags.detail: Official Arabian League 2nd Division footnotes 1 & 2 document that two Week 1 matches won on the Rift by Team Reds were administratively overturned to forfeit losses (`|ff=`) due to an ineligible player.
flags.resolution: Forfeit-aware `Data:` parser separates administrative `|ff=` rulings from on-Rift game losses (`w_ff=0.25`) and flags all Team Reds fixtures.

flags.category: Extreme Crowd vs. Real-Money Market Distortion
flags.title: Hotspawn Crowd Picks `Galions` at 86% vs. Real-Money 4-Venue Consensus 51.8% (`+34.2 pp` Distortion)
flags.detail: In EMEA Masters 2026 Summer Grand Final (#1081205 `Galions vs Solary`), Pinnacle (`-127 / +105` -> `53.2%`), Kalshi (`$0.535 / $0.455` -> `54.0%`), Polymarket (`$0.515 / $0.485` -> `51.5%`, `$25.6K` vol), and specialist esportsbooks (`1.86 / 1.80` -> `49.2%`) price a virtual coin flip (`52.4% Galions / 47.6% Solary`), whereas Hotspawn crowd sentiment sits at `86% / 14%` — proving why Hotspawn crowd % must never be used as win probability.
flags.resolution: All Hotspawn `picked_percent` fields are stripped prior to modeling and tested for exact `0.0` sensitivity in `tests/test_pipeline.py`.

flags.title: Identical Organization Names Across Distinct National Leagues (`Rich Gang`, `DMG`, `Invictus`, `Arena`, `Fenrir`)
flags.detail: `Rich Gang` fields separate rosters across Norway (`Komplettligaen`), DACH (`PRM Div 3.2`), UK (`4 Nations`), Sweden (`RIVALS League`), and Finland (`FPL`); `DMG Esports` fields separate Norwegian and Swedish rosters; `Invictus Gaming` (LPL Worlds) is unrelated to `Invictus Team` (Brazil) and `Macko Invictus` (Italy).
flags.resolution: Every team profile and rating vector is strictly scoped by `(competition_name, participant_name)` with zero global name merging.

flags.title: 69 Past-Lock Fixtures (`lock_time <= now`) Remain Unclosed with `status="scheduled"` on Hotspawn API
flags.detail: Hotspawn's live `/api/v1/fixtures?sport_alias=lol&status=scheduled&tenantId=1` endpoint returns 264 rows, of which 69 locked between Aug 26 and Oct 21, 2026 without score ingestion (`0–0`, `end_time=null`), including completed championships (`FPL Summer Playoffs`, `Legends Academy S3`, `POP Esports Masters S7`, `LIT Promotion`).
flags.resolution: Quarantined into `stale_locked` audit table and cross-matched against completed official Leaguepedia `Data:` scores.

flags.title: Hotspawn Feed Leaves `tier="waiting for information"` and `best_of=null` on 189 / 264 Fixtures
flags.detail: Hotspawn's API leaves `best_of: null` on 100% of scheduled rows and `tier: "waiting for information"` on 189/264 rows, which would mis-price Bo3 and Bo5 series if modeled as Bo1.
flags.resolution: Series format (`Bo1`/`Bo2`/`Bo3`/`Bo5`) and stage names are recovered from official Leaguepedia `Data:` schedules; unconfirmed tier fields remain explicitly blank (`—`).
